text.feels_intro: How {name}'s stab wounds feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a small puncture beads blood near {his} cheek or temple.
{name}'s face: a deep puncture has bled down {his} cheek; the skin around it is already swelling.
{name}'s face: a savage puncture through the cheek or brow; blood floods from it and {his} face is deathly pale.
body: {name}'s back: a small puncture wound weeps a thin line of blood.
{name}'s back: a deep stab wound, steady dark blood soaking {his} clothing around it.
{name}'s back: a deep stab wound into the torso; blood pulses from it and {his} breathing is wet and shallow.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a deep stab wound through the muscle, blood running steadily.
{name}'s {part}: the arm is skewered through; blood pours and the limb hangs useless.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a small puncture in the thigh or calf, oozing blood.
{name}'s {part}: a deep stab wound, blood running down into {his} boot.
{name}'s {part}: a deep, bleeding puncture through the muscle; the leg buckles under any weight.

head: {name}'s face has a sharp, pinpoint sting. {name} is wary and touches it, flinching at the blood.
{name}'s face throbs hot around the puncture. {name} is shaken and angry, holding {his} head very still.
{name}'s face is blinding pain and pressure; {he} is sick and dizzy. {name} is terrified and can hardly speak.
body: {name}'s back has a sharp, deep sting that catches on every breath. {name} is tense and watchful.
{name}'s back throbs deep inside and every breath stabs. {name} breathes shallowly and moves stiffly.
{name}'s back is a deep, spreading agony and breath is short and wet. {name} is frightened and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} has a sharp, pinpoint sting. {name} protects it and flexes the hand to test it.
{name}'s {part} throbs hard around the stab and goes weak when gripping. {name} cradles it.
{name}'s {part} is deep, burning agony and will not respond. {name} is in shock and cannot grip anything.
leg: {name}'s {part} has a sharp sting with each step. {name} is wary, testing the weight.
{name}'s {part} throbs deep and gives a sharp stab when loaded. {name} limps and winces.
{name}'s {part} is excruciating; it buckles when {he} tries to stand. {name} is panicked and needs help to move.

levels: , a sudden sharp stab. The point punches in and out, and {he} gasps as the pain blooms hot around it.
into a puncture that is already bleeding. The point drives deeper, and the pain flares, sharp and nauseating.

, and it is too much. The stab is crushing and cold; {he} goes ashen, {his} breath rattles and {his} knees give.

stage.medium: The stab wound on {name}'s {part} has closed over into a deep, bruised puncture.
stage.light: The puncture on {name}'s {part} has shrunk to a sore red dot.
stage.healed: The puncture on {name}'s {part} has healed, leaving a small pale scar.

heal.source_healed: All of {name}'s stab wounds have healed.
